items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember ever making a record with Clifford King? Clarinet King. [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: Yeah, I remember him saying he was playing with Cook. I remember that.
And... I wonder if that leads us into anybody on that clarinet. Do you remember ever making a record with Clifford King? Clarinet King.
